title: Database disk full from runaway export job
reason: The diagnosis accurately points to the PostgreSQL database, describes a disk‑full condition caused by a continuously running export job writing large CSVs.
root_cause: A newly deployed continuous data-export job writes large CSV files (10-15 GB each) every minute into /var/lib/postgresql/exports/, filling the 50 GB PostgreSQL data volume to 100 % and preventing PostgreSQL from extending its data files, which causes order‑placement failures and admin export timeouts.
truth: A new data export job runs every minute and writes large CSV files to /var/lib/postgresql/exports, filling the 50 GB database disk so PostgreSQL cannot write new data.
